name: CHAPSPaymentFailed
trigger: SVC-009 receives RTGS rejection of pacs.008 message (EXC-003) OR CHAPS bank cut-off passes after CHAPSPaymentAuthorised without successful submission (EXC-004). CHAPSPaymentExecution.submission_status set to failed. Reserved funds must be released by SVC-001 on consumption.
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for fund release. Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-001.

payload_schema.account_id: string (UUID v4) — account from which funds should be released
payload_schema.rejection_code: string (nullable) — ISO 20022 rejection reason code from RTGS (e.g. AM09, CH16)

consumers.action: Releases reserved funds from Account (ENT-004). Updates CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) status to failed. Triggers customer notification via SVC-053 with failure_reason and guidance.
Records payment failure with rejection_code for operations review and Bank of England CHAPS data quality reporting

ordering_guarantees: Per-customer. Published after EVT-110 and before any further intent events for the same chaps_intent_id. Terminal event for the payment lifecycle — no subsequent EVT-111 can follow EVT-113 for the same execution.
worm_rationale: Payment failure is auditable — evidence of attempt, RTGS rejection, and fund release. Required for CHAPS data quality audit programme (GOV-003-R03) and operations incident management.
